title: Saronic
description: A naval-industrial palette: pale steel paper (#f2f6fa) with deep navy ink, slate bands (#44505c) and an ink footer, one sonar-lime accent (#acff24) for every primary button. Small 4px radii, 8px media frames, a Swiss neo-grotesk with uppercase mono captions. Dark sibling: the whole page on slate, the same lime.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's dark bands use the .dark values (blocks put the `dark` class on them)
Host Grotesk stands in for Suisse Int'l (closed); Source Code Pro for Suisse Int'l Mono
in .dark, card (#162029) is the darker ink used by the footer; secondary is a 14% white veil for buttons over media
